title: Bullet 500 Trials (Explorer Pack)
description: Representing Royal Enfield's prowess in the Urban Roadster class, the Royal Enfield Bullet 500 Trials (Explorer Pack) is delivers authentic heritage styling paired with modern highway mile-munching comfort. A 500cc powerplant pumps out 44 HP and 38 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Upright Neutral layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
